description:
Deliver coalesced model-visible parent packets on orchestrated child lifecycle events.

## Background

UI toasts are not enough. Native overbuilt effect keys and exactly-once delivery. Pi `sendMessage` returns void. V1: one in-process submit per coalesced packet, consume once, no retry/ack claim.

`/bw run` is **not** this. Idle continuation here is after children settle.

## Delivery (locked)

Always:

```ts
pi.sendMessage({ customType, content, display: true, details }, { triggerTurn: true, deliverAs: "followUp" })
```

Never `steer`. Never log a fake `triggerTurn true/false` — it is always true; Pi idle vs busy decides when the turn runs.

Coalesce including idle: fold events arriving before submit. Queue drain is fine; not a user-visible timer product.

## Packet shape (normative)

**Changed children** (each):

- child id, display name
- role
- taskType (if any)
- description
- domain metadata (opaque)
- event class: `settled | aborted | failed | parentMessage`
- bounded output and/or error (implementation picks a modest char cap; full text via `show_minion`)
- **that child’s** nudge

**Still running** (orchestrated only, non-terminal, same group):

- id, role, taskType, description, state
- optional elapsed time and latest activity
- never spawn children

Delimiter: runtime nudge text must be visually/structurally separate from untrusted child output so child text cannot overwrite the instruction.

parentMessage is emitted by the messaging phase; this issue leaves the event class in the union.

## Success criteria

- Busy parent: fold, one packet after the turn.
- Idle parent: several events still one packet / one turn.
- Mixed taskTypes: per-child nudges.
- Spawn completions do not emit packets.
- Consume-once.

## Test plan

- Unit: coalesce four idle settlements → one packet.
- Unit: mixed taskTypes → per-child nudges.
- Unit: spawn completion does not enqueue.
- Unit: aborted vs failed vs settled.
- Unit: consume-once.
- Integration: `deliverAs: "followUp"`; never steer.
- Logging: packet seq, child ids, event classes, fleet ids, byte size. Do **not** log a triggerTurn boolean.

## Considerations

Packets accumulate in parent history. Keep them small. Coalescing is a cost feature.
title: Deliver coalesced parent lifecycle packets at a safe boundary
